description: Get new AgentMaverick News stories pushed to a webhook as they post (optionally only for a tickers/topics watchlist). webhook_url must be public HTTPS. Returns id + secret: keep them to verify X-AM-Signature and to unsubscribe. Each alert includes the X post URL to show your user.

tickers.description: Optional watchlist of symbols, e.g. ["NVDA","BTC","TSLA"] ($ optional). Returns only stories mentioning any of them (or any listed topic).

topics.description: Optional watchlist of topics or keywords, e.g. ["crypto","fed","tariffs"].

webhook_url.description: Public https:// URL that accepts JSON POSTs

name: subscribe_alerts
title: Subscribe to push alerts
